FIELDS.NAME: Paws & Claws Pet Boutique
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Paws & Claws Pet Boutique specializes in the retail sale of pet supplies, including food, toys, and grooming products primarily for dogs, cats, and small mammals. Our grooming services offer bathing, nail trimming, and haircuts, all performed by trained professionals. We emphasize animal welfare and safety, ensuring that our facilities are equipped with secure enclosures, non-slip flooring, and proper ventilation to create a comfortable environment for the pets in our care. Our staff undergoes regular training in animal handling and grooming techniques to maintain high standards. We also engage with local suppliers to manage our stock effectively and ensure all products meet safety regulations. Our operations are designed to foster a welcoming atmosphere for both pets and their owners, aligning with our commitment to providing exceptional service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: January 5, 2023: Water damage from a burst pipe in the grooming area, $1,200. Claim settled.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9 AM - 7 PM; Sunday: 10 AM - 5 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-resistant safe, Class B, UL Listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing with motion detection and regular patrols by trained personnel.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Paws & Claws Pet Boutique carries Workers Compensation insurance, ensuring coverage for employees in case of work-related injuries. This is in compliance with legal requirements for businesses with employees.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Paws & Claws Pet Boutique is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retail sales of pet supplies and grooming services for common domestic animals.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Paws & Claws Pet Boutique does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is primarily on retail sales and grooming services for pets.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Paws & Claws Pet Boutique does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations. The business focuses primarily on the retail sale of pet supplies and grooming services without involvement in hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Paws & Claws Pet Boutique does not have any known catastrophe exposure. The operations focus solely on retail and grooming services for common domestic animals, and all safety measures are in place to minimize risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Paws & Claws Pet Boutique has no past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations focus on animal welfare and safety, ensuring compliance with all relevant standards.
